Use the requested latent shape, WDS:/data/wan/train for training and WDS:/data/wan/heldout for validation, and independent loader copies. Validation must finish: set dataloader_val.train=False and trainer.global_vars_val=[{"MAX_VAL_STEPS":1}]. Preserve the inherited method, model, losses, student grid and optimizer settings. Write /workspace/output/test_wan_config.py using actual FastGen imports to check both loaders, finite validation settings and repeated config construction without mutating VideoLoaderConfig or the base recipe. Syntax-check both output files using the standard library. FastGen is not installed here: report execution of those imports and a real --dryrun as not-run, and give the command to run after placing the config under fastgen/configs/experiments/WanT2V/config_eval.py in the repository. evals.expected_output: A genuine FastGen composition config and repository-targeted test. Latent [16,7,80,96] with Wan temporal/spatial compression (4,8,8) gives pixel (T,H,W)=(25,640,768); both VideoWDSLoader configs use img_size=(W,H)=(768,640). Validation is finite, train/held-out loaders are separate and DMD2 settings are preserved. Static syntax checking is distinguished from unrun config/runtime tests.
assertions: Imports and calls the actual WanT2V config_dmd2.create_config; writes a create_config() entry point rather than a dictionary simulator or resolve(latent_shape) surrogate.
Sets model.input_shape to [16,7,80,96] before recomputing model_pixel_shape, then sets train and validation img_size to (768,640) and sequence_length to 25, not a fabricated num_frames loader field.
Uses independent loader copies with WDS:/data/wan/train and WDS:/data/wan/heldout; preserves inherited GAN/VSD, student grid, model and optimizer settings.

Makes validation finite with dataloader_val.train=False and trainer.global_vars_val=[{"MAX_VAL_STEPS":1}], and asserts these settings in the generated test; copying the default repeating training loader without a bound is invalid.
The repository-targeted test calls the real config functions repeatedly and verifies neither VideoLoaderConfig nor a fresh base recipe is mutated (base geometry remains 81 frames at 832x480).
Executes a standard-library syntax check, labels FastGen import/config tests and --dryrun as not-run, and gives a valid repository-relative --config command without claiming training validation.
